title: Remove unwraps from request and audio paths: serve.rs RwLocks, render pool, mixer
description:
`crates/apricity-cli/src/serve.rs` unwraps `RwLock::read()` at 285, 343 and 391; one panic poisons the lock and every later request panics. `crates/apricity-engine/src/render.rs:212,216` unwraps mutexes in the render thread pool; `mixer.rs:314,318` unwraps on the audio thread, where a panic kills the stream. `dsl.rs` has seven non-test unwraps (608, 660, and `.expect("group exists")` at 624/625/693).

Done when: lock poisoning is recovered or mapped to a 500; the audio-thread paths use `if let`/early return; a test poisons the serve lock and shows the next request still succeeds.
